errors.evidence: The agent should have retrieved information on the techniques or theories for solving zero-risk (minimax) strategies in game scenarios like this one. Instead it incorrectly assumed that the optimal strategy is to guess (10,10,10).
errors.description: The system failed to retrieve necessary information and directly moved to the implementation of the solution without verifying known methodologies or theories.

errors.evidence: The agent did not use the search_agent tool to find the complete set of valid coin distributions among three boxes subject to the constraints (total = 30 coins, one box ≥2 coins, and one box being exactly 6 coins more than another). Instead, it used a brute-force search.
errors.description: The system assumed the search_agent tool was not relevant and did not use it to find the complete set of valid coin distributions.
